description:
FlowiseAI is an open-source visual builder and REST runtime for LLM chatflows, AI agents, and RAG pipelines. This CLI gives an agent (or a human) the single binary needed to drive a self-hosted or Flowise Cloud instance: list and manage chatflows, run predictions with streaming, ingest documents into RAG document stores, replay any prediction by chatId, and audit responses against the source documents they cited.
Authentication uses a bearer token (instance-level API key via `FLOWISE_API_KEY`); the base URL points at your Flowise host (via `FLOWISE_BASE_URL`, default `http://localhost:3000`).
